# Giuseppe's Ristorante Italiano

> Authentic Sicilian Italian restaurant in Haymarket, Virginia, serving the Northern Virginia community since 1982. Family-owned and operated, offering housemade pastas, Neapolitan and Sicilian-style pizza, fresh seafood, veal and chicken classics, and full catering services.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://www.giuseppesva.com/)
- [Our Story](https://www.giuseppesva.com/about.html) — History and family background
- [Menu](https://www.giuseppesva.com/menu.html) — Full menu: antipasti, pizza, pasta, chicken, veal, seafood, subs, desserts
- [Dining](https://www.giuseppesva.com/dining.html) — Dining room and private dining information
- [Dopo Ora Speakeasy](https://www.giuseppesva.com/speakeasy.html) — Upstairs cocktail lounge
- [Events & Catering](https://www.giuseppesva.com/events.html) — Catering and banquet services
- [Contact](https://www.giuseppesva.com/contact.html) — Location, hours, and contact info

## Key Facts

- **Cuisine:** Authentic Sicilian Italian — housemade pasta, Neapolitan pizza, seafood, veal, chicken
- **Founded:** 1982 in Haymarket, Virginia
- **Family-owned and operated** for over 40 years
- **Address:** 15120 Washington Street, Haymarket, VA 20169
- **Phone:** 703-753-1004
- **Email:** info@giuseppesri.com
- **Hours:** Sun–Thu 10am–11pm, Fri–Sat 11am–1am
- **Price range:** $$ (moderate)
- **Reservations:** Walk-ins welcome; call ahead for large parties
- **Catering:** Available for private dinners, rehearsals, corporate events, and celebrations
- **Dopo Ora Speakeasy:** Cocktail lounge upstairs, open after hours
